subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw treat Volcano Engine Lite/Coding Plan UUID-like keys when a user selects a general Volcengine model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: Source shows the key is accepted by generic setup and reused across general and coding providers, but only a credentialed vendor check can decide whether this is a routing bug, a diagnostics gap, or expected entitlement separation.

options.title: Validate Lite route first
options.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys coding-only
options.body: If Lite keys are only valid for `volcengine-plan`, add earlier setup/model-selection diagnostics for users who pick general models.

options.title: Support shared key on both endpoints
options.body: If the key should work on the general endpoint too, fix the runtime credential/header path and add focused regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite route first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: This crosses provider auth aliases, bundled provider setup, and runtime compatibility surfaces where this history is strongest.
